Put list items into a random order. This free online list shuffler gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the List Shuffler

Start by typing or pasting your one item per line, then entering your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Type or paste your one item per line.
2. Enter your seed (deterministic — for games/demos only).
3. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
4. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Fisher–Yates shuffle swaps each item with a random earlier or equal position.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [List Shuffler](/list-shuffler) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Check the units and labels before comparing results.
- Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

Yes. It is free to use, with no sign-up or installation required. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [List Shuffler](/list-shuffler) and start straight away.

### Are my entries stored?

No. Calculations run in your browser and the tool does not save your entries. You can use it as often as you like, and because nothing is uploaded, stored or tracked, there is nothing to delete afterwards.

### What formula does the List Shuffler use?

Fisher–Yates shuffle swaps each item with a random earlier or equal position. You can see it in action in the [List Shuffler](/list-shuffler) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

Just One item per line and Seed (deterministic — for games/demos only). Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
